scope: one parent seed, two reused phases, diagnostic only
joint_coordinates: first three class fractions per core, two cores per pair
bootstrap_unit: whole draw address, shared across all cases, phases and arms

interpretation.coarse_dominated: B point ratio <=1.5 in both phases AND upper(B)<lower(A) in both phases
interpretation.coarse_not_implicated: B point ratio >=2 in at least one phase AND B and A ranges overlap in that same phase
interpretation.eligibility: A and B must share the full-cap sampling law, operator, supports, cores, truth and fine-noise addresses
interpretation.caution: Rule labels are diagnostic routing decisions, not causal proof or population calibration certification
interpretation.reported_meaning_coarse_dominated: Evidence that the coarse-conditioning pathway contributes materially; does not distinguish coarse posterior from handoff
interpretation.reported_meaning_coarse_not_implicated: A substantial defect persists with true coarse; does not exonerate the coarse factor

variance_difference: trace(mean S_A)-trace(mean S_B); descriptive, not a causal variance decomposition

power.residual: physical fine density minus blockwise lift of its own uncorrupted coarse mass
power.geometry: same 32 registered production windows as sampler_factor_20261005_v1
power.summary: ratio of equal-window mean draw-averaged power to equal-window mean true power, separately per phase
power.uncovered_cells: existing fixed production support; common historical coarse-only fill, giving zero generated residual outside coverage
